channelGoneHint: This channel is not available now, so messages go by the next one. The setting is kept and works again when it is back.

notif.title: Notifications
notif.hint: How and when Ziira messages you. The business's own settings apply to anything you leave on the default.

kindHint.alerts: Serious things and reminders for you.
kindHint.approvals: Things waiting for your decision. A chat channel lets you reply to approve.

notif.languageHint: Used for the wording of messages sent to you.
notif.quietHint: Messages that arrive during quiet hours wait until they end. They are never dropped. Times are read in the company's time zone.
notif.phoneHint: With the country code, or the number as you dial it locally.
notif.codeWaiting: A code was sent to {{phone}}. It expires in 15 minutes.
notif.removeAsk: Remove this number? You will no longer be messaged on chat channels, and replies from it will be ignored.
notif.numberHint: To approve or reject by replying in a chat channel, prove the number is yours: a code is sent to it (by the first channel your business has set up that reaches it; by email last). A number nobody has verified is never messaged in chat and its replies are ignored.

noChannelsHint: Switch on a messaging plugin (Add-ons) to send messages.
